requirements.description: Replace the _get_plot_df helper with a pytest fixture (plot_data) on BasePlottingTests that the plot tests receive as an argument.

label.evidence: pandas/tests/extension/base/plotting.py after code: _get_plot_df removed; @pytest.fixture plot_data in BasePlottingTests (about lines 126-131); test_plot_on_x_axis/test_plot_on_y_axis take plot_data
label.notes: Reviewer asked for the DataFrame-building helper to become a fixture on BasePlottingTests; _get_plot_df is removed and a plot_data fixture is added and used by the x/y-axis tests (author reply points to d1c1e10). The fixture is also parametrized on skipna, which the author proposed and the reviewer did not object to.
